about: Our apps, shown in each app's «المزيد من تطبيقاتنا» sheet (never the app itself). Each app: id (Android application id), status (released: install button; soon: «قريبًا», no action), icon (a square PNG, about 144 px, in app-icons/ or a full https link), name, line (the short description) and tags. Tags are defined once under tags: text in each language and a colour (green, blue, orange, purple, gold). To add an app: upload its icon to app-icons/ and add an entry to apps. The apps show in this order. website: our website, shown as a card in each app's settings: url (the link; change it to move the apps to a new site), name (the studio's name, also its initials in the card's logo), line and button (the button's text). Shown again on Nov 15, 2026 (owner): faseehstudio.com.

line.en: Learning apps for Arabic and the Quran
